page_title: BRE 2-2 CHE | Brentford v Chelsea 02/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' The foul by Ivan Toney (Brentford) was seen by Jarred Gillett who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
90+3' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90+2' Chelsea have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.
90+1' Zanka (Brentford) is booked.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Mark Flekken gets down to his right to keep it out.
87' Thomas Frank has decided to make a change. Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) replaces Vitaly Janelt.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Neal Maupay (Brentford) is coming onto the pitch as Yoane Wissa cannot continue after picking up an injury.
87' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
83' 2 - 2 Goal! Cole Palmer plays a neat lofted pass into the box for Axel Disasi (Chelsea), who beats the defender in the air and plants a header into the roof of the net from close range. 2:2.
83' Chelsea quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
83' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) takes a short corner kick.
82' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
81' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Chelsea.
79' Mauricio Pochettino has decided to substitute Levi Colwill and he is replaced by Raheem Sterling (Chelsea).
79' Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the left post.
77' The manager makes a subsitution with Mathias Jensen (Brentford) coming on for Frank Onyeka.
77' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
75' The referee signals a free kick. Chelsea are going to take it from long range.
75' Chelsea seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
73' Frank Onyeka (Brentford) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
71' Mauricio Pochettino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) replacing Enzo Fernandez.

69' 2 - 1 What a GOAL that is! Yoane Wissa (Brentford) showed great determination to get to the ball inside the box and acrobatically launched himself into the air and produced a scissor kick of the highest quality to leave Djordje Petrovic helpless. He makes it 2:1.
69' A crossfield pass from Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea) fails to find any of his teammates. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Brentford.
66' Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) makes room to connect with a cross, but his strike from the penalty spot isn't accurate at all and the ball goes well over the bar.
65' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Jarred Gillett who sees an offensive foul.
61' CHANCE! Malo Gusto finds Cole Palmer (Chelsea) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the left post!
60' The ball possession is 28:72.
59' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
57' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
57' It seemed like Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
55' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) releases Conor Gallagher, who latched on to his perfect through pass and can continue with his team's attack.
54' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
53' POST! Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the right post. What a strike that was!
50' 1 - 1 Goal! Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:1.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Jarred Gillett has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mark Flekken, who smothers the ball.
45+1' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
43' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
43' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) takes it short.

41' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Mark Flekken, who tips the ball around the post.
40' The current number of shots on goal is 1:2.
38' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.

35' 0 - 1 Malo Gusto sends a superb cross into the box. Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) latches on to it and from close range plants a header into the bottom left corner, leaving Mark Flekken beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 0:1.
31' The resulting set piece from Chelsea is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
29' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) sends a long ball forward to Malo Gusto, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.

26' What a wasted opportunity by Yoane Wissa (Brentford)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Djordje Petrovic makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
25' Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jarred Gillett blows for a foul.

24' What a miss! Yoane Wissa (Brentford) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
23' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
22' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) sends an accurate short pass. Conor Gallagher controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
19' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
16' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
14' Brentford will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
11' Ivan Toney (Brentford) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
9' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
9' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) works the corner short.
7' The Chelsea players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
5' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
3' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Chelsea will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Jarred Gillett.
